latest.title: Floor plans for every building, and a Layout filter
latest.summary: Each building the finder lists now names its layout, the game's short code for its shape, such as C1 or H3. Click a building on the map or in the list and its card shows the game's own floor plan for it, with its entrances (loading bays for a warehouse). A new Layout filter in Find a location lists only the layouts you pick, and a saved search keeps it.
